sentences.en: My mother and I opened his chest.
We found clothes and a weapon and a bag of money.

sentences.ar: وتحت كل إشي، لقينا ورق مربوط.
sentences.en: And under everything, we found tied papers.
My mother was counting the money by the light.
We heard the sound of a stick on the road.

sentences.ar: أخذت الورق وهربنا من الباب الخلفي.
sentences.en: I took the papers and we fled from the back door.
